Scholarship overview

This Surrey project develops federated machine unlearning: methods for removing the influence of selected data from distributed models. The aim is to make removal verifiable while protecting privacy and preserving useful model performance.

Research Areas

  • Machine learning
  • Privacy-preserving AI
  • Computer science

Surrey offers doctoral research in science, engineering, health and other fields. Its advertised studentships set out a defined research problem, supervision arrangements and the funding available for that project.
